primitives.name: End-Frame Reveal Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## The trick: end-frame reveal `seedance_2_0` accepts an end frame (`--end-image`).
primitives.assumptions: The system assumes a pre-approved cover image exists and is accessible via local path or UUID. Motion model must support end-frame anchoring.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Motion model fails if start frame is passed instead of end frame, causing drift rather than reveal.

layer2.mapping: GSI infers motion dynamics from cover content; GSE executes temporal sequence with fixed endpoint.
layer2.telemetry: Pixel-perfect alignment of final frame validated via visual regression.

primitives.name: Content-Derived Beat Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: Design the beats (~5s), all derived from the cover's actual content 1.
primitives.assumptions: Each beat segment corresponds to distinct visual elements (scene, text, settle). Temporal durations are fixed but adjustable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when beat timing does not align with content semantics or exceeds 15 seconds.

layer2.mapping: GSI encodes semantic structure into temporal segments; GSE enforces timing constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Beat segmentation verified through motion vector consistency across time steps.

primitives.name: Permission-Gated Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: OFFER it when publishing > ("want a short cover video for the feed card?") and only generate it after > the user says yes — never unprompted.
primitives.assumptions: User intent is captured via explicit confirmation before resource allocation. Credit system governs access.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System fails if generation proceeds without user consent or credit validation.

layer2.mapping: GSI models user decision process; GSE enforces conditional execution based on intent signal.
layer2.telemetry: Generation log records user confirmation timestamp and credit deduction.
